role: independent Marathi editorial review of upstream integration delta
references_actual_read: Native [Win chance] = जिंकण्याची शक्यता; [Win chance: %0 · Fitness: %1] uses same phrase
Native probability threshold/outcome wording and model-confidence help text
Upstream MetricCatalog.cpp chart.winProbability samples with ticks and permille/10 values
WinProbability.h per-alliance competitor contract; documented aggregate features and AI calibration campaign
online_reference_limit: Current portal mr/en catalogs have no dedicated win-probability or alliance UI key. The one probability occurrence concerns resource growth and is not a suitable label anchor; existing native player-facing win-chance labels are the direct reference.

entries.disposition: accept Google label unchanged; consistent with existing [Win chance]
rationale: Natural concise probability label; preserve existing vocabulary.

entries.source: Estimated chance of your alliance winning, sampled throughout the match. Allies share one probability. This model was trained on AI games; estimates do not account for position or planned moves. Older saves may have incomplete history.
entries.google_draft: तुमच्या गटाच्या जिंकण्याची अंदाजित शक्यता, जी संपूर्ण सामन्यादरम्यान तपासली जाते. सर्व गटांची संभाव्यता एकच असते. हे मॉडेल एआय (AI) खेळांवर प्रशिक्षित केले गेले आहे; या अंदाजांमध्ये स्थिती किंवा नियोजित चालींचा विचार केलेला नाही. जुन्या सेव्ह फाइल्समध्ये अपूर्ण इतिहास असू शकतो.
entries.proposed_final: तुमची युती जिंकण्याची अंदाजित शक्यता, जी संपूर्ण सामन्यादरम्यान वेळोवेळी नोंदवली जाते. एका युतीतील सर्वांसाठी ही शक्यता एकच असते. हे मॉडेल एआय सामन्यांच्या आधारे प्रशिक्षित केलेले आहे; अंदाजात नकाशावरील स्थान किंवा नियोजित चालींचा विचार केला जात नाही. जुन्या जतन केलेल्या खेळांमध्ये या नोंदी अपूर्ण असू शकतात.
entries.disposition: revise alliance scope, actual sampled-history meaning, spatial-position limitation and natural Marathi
rationale: जिंकण्याची शक्यता matches existing [Win chance] and [Win chance: %0 · Fitness: %1].
Use established युती; Google गट weakens the specific alliance concept.
Google सर्व गटांची संभाव्यता एकच incorrectly claims ALL groups have equal probability. Same value is shared only by allies within ONE alliance.
वेळोवेळी नोंदवली जाते captures time-series samples; तपासली जाते merely says checked.
नकाशावरील स्थान preserves spatial-position limit; स्थिती could falsely imply the model ignores game state, despite its unit/prestige/attack/food features.
Model training on AI matches is retained, without redundant added (AI).
Old-save caveat concerns incomplete probability history, not a broken or incompatible saved game.

width_assessment: Keep short existing Win chance wording for the metric label. Description is an explanatory paragraph; normal wrapping preserves meaning without cramped invented abbreviations. Actual final HUD/tooltip layout must be checked on the integrated build.
